Third-party libraries bundled with OMG Rental
=============================================

jsQR 1.4.0 — QR code reader (used when the browser has no built-in BarcodeDetector)
  https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
  Copyright Cosmo Wolfe. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

qrcode-generator 1.4.4 — QR code generator for printable item tags
  https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
  Copyright (c) 2009 Kazuhiko Arase. Licensed under the MIT License.
  The word "QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
